purpose: License data of the Rust crates statically linked into the cryptography, pydantic_core and rpds-py wheels, read by tools/write_third_party_notices.py. The build lists the crates of the SBOM in each installed wheel and fails for a crate that is not in this file: rerun the license research for the new crates and add them here.

obligation_values.shared-apache: Apache-2.0 chosen; listed by name, the text is printed once under 'Shared license texts' (plus a notice, if any)
obligation_values.text: MIT/BSD/Unicode-style text: copyright lines and the text are printed

text_note: The license texts are the text as published on crates.io (via the docs.rs source view), line endings LF; they are not the upstream bytes. Each file is pinned by sha256.
